metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: Directed by Denis Villeneuve, who did Sicario, this is an intensely dark and emotionally complex kidnapping thriller.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: A gritty, high-stakes crime drama with a relentless antagonist that matches your interest in Sicario and Shawshank Redemption.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: A psychological mystery with intricate plotting similar to Gone Girl and Exam.

metas.name: Ex Machina
metas.description: A cerebral sci-fi thriller that explores artificial intelligence and manipulation, much like The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A dark character study of a sociopathic videographer that offers the same intensity as Gone Girl.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: A prestige horror film with deep themes and a suffocating atmosphere that aligns with your taste for high-quality horror like Smile 2.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Smart, high-concept science fiction that demands attention and emotional investment, following your interest in The Abyss.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: An intensely disturbing horror-drama that focuses on grief and psychological trauma, perfect for a fan of The Conjuring 2.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: A prestige character study featuring a powerhouse performance, similar in weight and tone to The Master.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: A psychological mystery with a dark, twisty narrative that fits your preference for intense thrillers.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: A masterclass in dark comedy and social thriller elements, blending genres in a way similar to In Bruges.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: A meticulous crime mystery that focuses on the obsession of investigation, similar to the tension in Conclave.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: A gritty, cold-climate crime thriller written by Taylor Sheridan (Sicario) with high emotional stakes.

metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: A slow-burn psychological thriller set in a single location, matching the 'bottle movie' tension of Exam.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: A gritty, intense sci-fi thriller with incredible cinematography that parallels the survival elements of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: An emotionally devastating mystery about family secrets that is as challenging as it is rewarding.

metas.name: Talk to Me
metas.description: A fresh and intense modern horror movie that uses supernatural elements to explore psychological themes, like Smile 2.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A sharp dark comedy with high stakes and social commentary, fitting your interest in Bugonia and Parasite-style films.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: A low-budget, high-concept sci-fi mystery that relies on dialogue and psychological tension like The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: From the director of In Bruges and Seven Psychopaths, this is a dark, tragicomic look at a broken friendship.

metas.name: Uncut Gems
metas.description: A high-anxiety thriller that is relentless from start to finish, providing the intensity you crave.

metas.name: Eastern Promises
metas.description: A gritty, violent crime drama that dives deep into the London underworld, matching the tone of Sicario.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: An intense, stylistically bold psychological horror film that is both surreal and challenging.

metas.name: Green Room
metas.description: A visceral and gritty survival thriller that pits a band against a group of skinheads in a claustrophobic setting.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: A bright but deeply disturbing folk horror film that deals with psychological manipulation and grief.

metas.name: Margin Call
metas.description: A high-stakes corporate drama that relies on sharp dialogue and mounting dread, similar in energy to Conclave.

metas.name: Train to Busan
metas.description: A high-intensity horror thriller that offers a more emotional and fast-paced take on the zombie genre like 28 Days Later.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: A dark, prestige mystery thriller with a complex female lead, very much in the vein of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Fargo
metas.description: A classic blend of gritty crime and dark comedy, perfectly aligned with your interest in Seven Psychopaths.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description: A modern western/crime thriller with deep character work and a gritty atmosphere similar to Sicario.

metas.name: The Handmaiden
metas.description: A visually stunning and psychologically complex thriller full of twists and high-stakes manipulation.

metas.name: The Conversation
metas.description: A classic psychological thriller about surveillance and paranoia that demands the viewer's full attention.

metas.name: A Prophet
metas.description: A gritty and realistic prison drama that is much darker and more intense than The Shawshank Redemption.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: A thoughtful and isolated sci-fi drama that focuses on the psychological state of its protagonist, similar to The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: An intense, prestige drama about an investigation into a systemic cover-up, matching the intellectual tone of Conclave.

metas.name: Possessor
metas.description: A visceral sci-fi horror/thriller about identity and control that is both graphically intense and intellectually challenging.

metas.name: Barbarian
metas.description: A unpredictable horror film that constantly shifts gears, offering the same modern intensity as Smile 2.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description: A dark, atmospheric, and highly artistic sci-fi film that is deeply unsettling and unique.

metas.name: The Killer
metas.description: A cold, methodical thriller from David Fincher (Gone Girl) about an assassin's internal process.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A tense, claustrophobic psychological thriller that keeps you guessing about the truth, much like Exam.
